SELECT pc.cat_id, pc.brand, pi.part_id, pi.brand, pi.model, ps.ps_id, ps.supplier_id, psp.price_type, psp.currency, psp.price_value, psp.moq, psp.lead_time, psp.effect_date, s.supplier_name FROM part_info pi LEFT JOIN part_category pc ON pi.cat_id = pc.cat_id LEFT JOIN part_supplier ps ON ps.part_id = pi.part_id AND ps.auth_status=1 LEFT JOIN supplier s ON ps.supplier_id=s.supplier_id AND s.status=1 LEFT JOIN part_supplier_price psp ON ps.ps_id=psp.ps_id AND (psp.expire_date IS NULL OR psp.expire_date > NOW())
AND pi.publishing_status = '1'
AND pi.part_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.partName}, '%')
AND psp.price_type = #{dto.priceType}

SELECT pc.cat_id, pc.brand, pi.part_id, pi.brand, pi.model, ps.ps_id, ps.supplier_id, psp.price_type, psp.currency, psp.price_value, psp.moq, psp.lead_time, psp.effect_date, psp.expire_date, psp.create_user_id, psp.create_time, s.supplier_name FROM part_info pi LEFT JOIN part_category pc ON pi.cat_id = pc.cat_id LEFT JOIN part_supplier ps ON ps.part_id = pi.part_id AND ps.auth_status=1 LEFT JOIN supplier s ON ps.supplier_id=s.supplier_id AND s.status=1 LEFT JOIN part_supplier_price psp ON ps.ps_id=psp.ps_id AND (psp.expire_date IS NULL OR psp.expire_date > NOW())
AND pi.publishing_status = '1'
AND pi.part_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.partName}, '%')
